title: T-A11Y-SCREENS-2: TalkBack labels for Approvals, Connectors, Project, Diary, and Agent screens
head: claude/t-a11y-screens-2
body:
Part 2 of TalkBack accessibility pass for clickable rows.

Changes:
- ApprovalsScreen.kt: `ApprovalCard`, `ConnectorRequestCard`, `ApprovalHistoryList` get `clearAndSetSemantics`
- ConnectorsScreen.kt: `RequestRow`, `CategoryHeaderRow`, `ConnectorRow`, `LogsToggleRow`, `ConnectorLogRow` get `clearAndSetSemantics`
- ProjectScreen.kt: `ProgressTab` tasks, `BuildsTab` builds, `FilesTab` files get `clearAndSetSemantics`
- DiaryScreen.kt: `DiaryEntryCard` gets `clearAndSetSemantics`
- AgentScreen.kt: `PixelTabs` tabs, `AgentHeader` goal expand, `CopyMessageButton` get `clearAndSetSemantics`

Pattern: `val open = onClickAction` alias, `clickable` then `clearAndSetSemantics { contentDescription; role = Role.Button; onClick(label) { open(); true } }`
Decorative icons get `contentDescription = null`.
Parameter renamed from `onClick` to `onClickAction` to avoid shadowing `SemanticsPropertyReceiver.onClick`.

Code written without compiler; needs CI verification.
